title: Men Constructing Wooden Shed in Yard, 1950s B&W Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot showing two men in jackets and work caps inspecting or constructing a long wooden shed or outbuilding. In the foreground, a low retaining barrier of white-painted horizontal planks and dark vertical posts holds back the ground, adjacent to a large pile of broken rocks, tiles, and rubble. Tall trees and overhead wires rise behind the structure in bright daylight.
